blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A woman chose prison over an abusive home — after 11 years of enduring escalating physical and psychological abuse from her husband, a police officer. Court records showed she was beaten about four times a week, starting after she caught him in bed with another woman. When she threatened to leave, he choked her and pointed a firearm at her. Fearing retaliation and mistrusting the authorities, she chose silence. However, the violence continued. When she attempted to ask for help from neighbors, he threatened to kill her.
